title: You lose what you keep, but you keep what you give away.
paragraphs: You lose what you keep, but you keep what you give away.
The hardest battle a warrior faces isn't against an enemy—it's against the urge to control the outcome. We hold on so tight because we’re afraid, but a clenched fist cannot receive.
God doesn’t want your perfection; He wants your surrender. When you place your fear, your dreams, and your struggle into His hands, He doesn't just hold them—He multiplies them.
Are you brave enough to let go today?
📖 The Word: "For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it." — Matthew 16:25
